title: Item Flow Observed schema
description: Schema for observations of the movement of items at a location during a given period

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It has to be ItemFlowObserved

averageGapDistance.description: Property. Average distance between two consecutive detected items

averageHeadwayTime.description: Property. Average elapsed time between two consecutive items

averageLength.description: Property. Average length of the items detected during the observation period

averageSpeed.description: Property. Average speed of detected items in transit during the observation period

congested.description: Property. Whether congestion occurred during the observation period; absence means false

dateObservedFrom.description: Property. Inclusive lower bound of the observation period

dateObservedTo.description: Property. Inclusive upper bound of the observation period

intensity.description: Property. Total number of items detected during the observation period

itemSubType.description: Property. Reference to a subType attribute identifier of an NGSI entity

itemType.description: Property. Reference to an existing or future NGSI-LD entity type identifier

laneDirection.description: Property. Usual direction of travel in the lane referred to by this observation

laneId.description: Property. Lane identifier following the RoadSegment conventions based on OpenStreetMap

occupancy.description: Property. Fraction of the observation time during which an item occupied the observed lane

refDevice.description: Relationship. Device that performed the measurement

refRoadSegment.description: Relationship. Road segment on which the observation was made

reverseLane.description: Property. Whether traffic in the lane was reversed during the observation period; absence means false

maxSpeed.description: Property. Maximum speed detected during the observation period

minSpeed.description: Property. Minimum speed detected during the observation period
